label: Metrically finite populated pasts from spaced Grim Reaper pieces and patchwork
description: Non-transcription conditional support option for the metric denial of horn H2: no populated past in an accessible history is metrically infinite. Time is linearly ordered (a type-class assumption of the theorem, not a premise statement) and measured by a supplied real clock strictly increasing along it. Suppose a contingent concrete thing is present at t in an accessible history and the clock readings of the moments at or before t are unbounded below; choice gives a strictly descending sequence from t whose slots each last more than one clock unit. The spaced local premise makes every two adjacent Reaper pieces along it co-possible; spaced patchwork gives one accessible world realizing all of them; the verified GrimReaperPatchwork.arrangementImpossible, which composes IndexedSignalReaper.impossible, refutes that world. Each premise holds without the other in a beginningless integer history (control 1). The premises are silent about every metrically finite past, so they are satisfiable, for every register frame, by a populated past that is open below and finite (positive real times, control 2) and by continuous time with a first moment (non-negative real times, control 3): read with the privileged clock (CLOCK_1), under which an FLRW past is finite, neither the FLRW objection nor the Benardete parity objection to the order-theoretic GrimReaperPatchwork premises has a target in the typed premises. The theorem holds for every real clock; a real clock exists only for time orders embedding in the reals, so the countable coinitiality of GrimReaperPatchwork is absorbed into the clock's existence, not eliminated. The warrant of spaced patchwork is unchanged unless a duration-sensitive recombination principle is adopted. The conclusion does NOT give a past with a beginning: control 2 satisfies both premises and the conclusion with no begun populated moment, and there, with the earlier-grounded possibility premise, begun coming-to-be (A3 prime w) is not possible. Both premises are OPEN. Nothing is attributed to Koons or Pruss. No premise is established.
